knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A session has one agreed goal.
Results are not guaranteed and progress notes do not promise them.
Terms are shown before payment so the family can agree.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a learner goal and checks that the candidate writes a session plan with a start, practice and review
Assessor reviews a progress note for factual content and absence of any guarantee
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Price and cancellation terms as shown
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate guarantees a test or exam result
The candidate offers a discount in return for a review
